name: co.seatac/rides
title: Seatac Co trip planner
description: Plan and book a whole SEA or Seattle trip: rides, hotels, flights, cruises, tours, in one plan link.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Creates a trip plan for a trip through Seattle-Tacoma Airport (SEA) or Seattle: rides, hotel, flights, a cruise from Seattle, tours and events in one plan, timed so it fits. Give the arrival date (or a cruise sailing), travelers, and anything already known; you can add the rest later with add_to_plan. Creates a stored plan and returns plan_id, edit_key (keep private; needed to change it), plan_url (the visual, shareable plan page: show this to the traveler), summary_markdown, what's still needed, warnings, and hotel_options. The rides between the airport, hotel, pier and stops are planned automatically. Nothing is booked or charged: the traveler books from plan_url.

start.description: The day they arrive in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional with a cruise (default: the day before sailing).

end.description: The day they leave (no cruise), YYYY-MM-DD. Or give nights.

nights.description: Nights in Seattle instead of end (0-21, default 2). With a cruise the Seattle nights run to sailing day.

kids.description: How many of them are kids (default 0).

purpose.description: vacation (default), business, visit, event or other.

cruise_ship.description: A cruise from Seattle: the ship (from find_cruise_sailings).

cruise_sail_date.description: The sailing date in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

event_id.description: A trip built around one game, concert or show: its pick_id (ev-<slug>) from find_events_near. Give event_date too; it sets the dates (start defaults to that day) and purpose event, and puts the event on its day.

local.description: They live in the Seattle area: no flight or hotel; the plan offers the ride there and back (by licensed partners) or parking. With an event and no end, a same-day plan.

home_airport.description: flight: 3-letter code they fly from, e.g. ORD.

arrival_flight.description: flight: arriving flight number, e.g. AS 23, only once booked (the plan then shows the flight in as booked). Before that give landing_time, or search_flights.

landing_time.description: flight: landing at SEA, Seattle time HH:MM.

departure_time.description: flight: flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM.

hotel_slug.description: One of our hotels (slug from hotel_options of an earlier answer, or recommend_hotels_with_rides).

hotel_name.description: hotel: or a hotel booked elsewhere, "name, address".

items.description: More to put on the plan right away (up to 12), each like add_to_plan's item, e.g. {"type":"tour","id":"space-needle","date":"2027-05-05"}.

id.description: tour/experience: pick_id from find_things_to_do (e.g. space-needle). restaurant: pick_id from find_restaurants (eat-...). event: ev-<slug> from find_events_near.

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD), a day in Seattle on the plan. Needed for tours, restaurants, events, meetings; optional for parking and rental_car.

part.description: Part of the day: morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner or evening (default: when it usually fits).

hotel_slug.description: hotel: one of hotel_options (bookable on seatac.co).

hotel_name.description: hotel: or a hotel booked elsewhere, "name, address".

sail_date.description: cruise: embarkation date in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

home_airport.description: flight: 3-letter code they fly from, e.g. ORD.

arrival_flight.description: flight: arriving flight number, e.g. AS 23, only once booked (the plan then shows the flight in as booked). Before that give landing_time, or search_flights.

landing_time.description: flight: landing at SEA, Seattle time HH:MM.

departure_time.description: flight: flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM.

name.description: meeting: a short label, e.g. Client meeting. No personal details.

address.description: meeting: where it is (a business address).

already_booked.description: hotel, flight, cruise, tour: the traveler already booked it (shown as booked).

tools.name: add_to_plan
tools.description: Add one thing to a plan: hotel, flight details, cruise, tour or experience, restaurant, event, meeting, parking or rental_car (rides are planned automatically). A hotel, flight or cruise replaces the one already in the plan. Adding the same thing again changes nothing. Returns item_id (for remove_from_plan), the updated summary and the same plan_url, which now shows it.

edit_key.description: edit_key from plan_trip. Keep it private: it lets you change the plan.

id.description: tour/experience: pick_id from find_things_to_do (e.g. space-needle). restaurant: pick_id from find_restaurants (eat-...). event: ev-<slug> from find_events_near.

date.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD), a day in Seattle on the plan. Needed for tours, restaurants, events, meetings; optional for parking and rental_car.

part.description: Part of the day: morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner or evening (default: when it usually fits).

hotel_slug.description: hotel: one of hotel_options (bookable on seatac.co).

hotel_name.description: hotel: or a hotel booked elsewhere, "name, address".

sail_date.description: cruise: embarkation date in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

home_airport.description: flight: 3-letter code they fly from, e.g. ORD.

arrival_flight.description: flight: arriving flight number, e.g. AS 23, only once booked (the plan then shows the flight in as booked). Before that give landing_time, or search_flights.

landing_time.description: flight: landing at SEA, Seattle time HH:MM.

departure_time.description: flight: flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM.

name.description: meeting: a short label, e.g. Client meeting. No personal details.

address.description: meeting: where it is (a business address).

already_booked.description: hotel, flight, cruise, tour: the traveler already booked it (shown as booked).

tools.name: remove_from_plan
tools.description: Take one thing off a plan by its item_id (from add_to_plan or get_plan), or "hotel", "flight" or "cruise". Returns the updated summary and plan_url.

edit_key.description: edit_key from plan_trip. Keep it private: it lets you change the plan.

item_id.description: item_id, or hotel, flight or cruise.

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description: Check a plan before booking: timing problems (a flight home too early for the ship, a stop that makes them late), what's still missing (hotel, flight times), rides that can't be booked yet, the cost so far line by line, hotel options, and booking_order: every part to book (the trip, the flight, the hotel, the rides; any order, a suggested next), what's done, and which rides still wait for the flight, hotel or sailing they connect to. Read-only.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read a plan: every day in order with its steps (flights, rides with pickup times and estimates, hotel, the cruise, things to do), what's booked, item_ids, the estimated total, summary_markdown to show in the chat, and plan_url, the visual plan page to share. Read-only.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: When the traveler is ready to book: returns checkout_url, the one link to send them. It opens "Book your trip" on seatac.co, which lists every part to book, in any order, each paid on its own: the trip itself (the cruise or event tickets, with a partner), the flight (with a partner), the hotel (on seatac.co's room page), and the rides (by licensed partner operators, paid together in one card payment on seatac.co), timed to the flight, hotel and sailing. A ride waits only for what it connects to: to or from Seatac for its flight, to or from the hotel for the hotel, to or from the pier for the sailing (booked, booked elsewhere or not needed all unlock it); a waiting ride says so in waits_for. booking_order lists each part, its items and a suggested next. This tool books and charges nothing; the traveler confirms and pays on seatac.co.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Describe Seatac Co: private, pre-booked rides between Seatac Airport and the Seattle area, plus hourly charters. Returns the service area, vehicle types with passenger and bag capacity, booking requirements, and the cancellation and refund policy. Fares are quoted per trip; use quote_ride for a live price.

tools.name: quote_ride
tools.description: Get the live fare for a specific Seatac Co ride, per eligible vehicle, priced exactly as seatac.co checkout prices it. Each vehicle includes a booking_url where the customer reviews and pays. Rate limited; reuse a quote instead of re-requesting it.

pickup.description: Pickup location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle".

dropoff.description: Drop-off location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Optional for hourly charters.

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is read as Seattle local time (America/Los_Angeles), e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

flight_number.description: Optional flight number for Seatac pickups or drop-offs, e.g. AS 123.

hours.description: Set only for an hourly charter: the number of hours (1-24).

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Create a prefilled seatac.co reservation link for the customer to open. They review the trip, enter contact details, and pay on seatac.co. Nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

pickup.description: Pickup location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle".

dropoff.description: Drop-off location. Street address, hotel, or place in the Seattle area, e.g. "Seattle-Tacoma International Airport", "Pier 91", "Hyatt Regency Bellevue", or "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Optional for hourly charters.

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is read as Seattle local time (America/Los_Angeles), e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30. Optional.

flight_number.description: Optional flight number for Seatac pickups or drop-offs, e.g. AS 123.

hours.description: Set only for an hourly charter: the number of hours (1-24).

vehicle_slug.description: Optional vehicle_slug from quote_ride or get_service_info to preselect.

tools.name: find_cruise_sailings
tools.description: Look up Seattle cruise sailings from the Port of Seattle schedule (2026 season and the preliminary 2027 season): which pier and terminal a ship uses on a date, and which ships sail on a day. Filter by ship (fuzzy), cruise_line, date or from/to, and pier. Each upcoming embarkation (turnaround) day includes ride_to_pier with a prefilled seatac.co booking link from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport; call quote_ride with its quote_ride_arguments plus a pickup time for the live fare. Without a date filter, only sailings from today on are returned.

ship.description: Ship name, any case; partial names work, e.g. "Norwegian Bliss" or "Bliss".

from.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

to.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Live airfares for a trip to or from Seattle (SEA), cheapest first, priced exactly as seatac.co prices them (taxes and fees included, USD). Each result lists the flights, times, stops, fare terms and bags; booking_url opens seatac.co's flight search on the same trip, where the traveler picks the flight and pays. One of origin or destination must be SEA. Rate limited; reuse results instead of re-searching.

origin.description: 3-letter airport code, e.g. SEA or JFK.

destination.description: 3-letter airport code, e.g. LAX or SEA.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip; omit for one way.

tools.name: check_hotel_prices
tools.description: Live room prices for Seattle-area hotels on given dates: the lowest total for the stay (2 adults, 1 room, USD, our price as seatac.co shows it). near is a cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91) or a hotel area. Each hotel's rooms_url opens its seatac.co page on those dates, where the traveler picks a room and pays, and can add the ride from Seatac. Rate limited; reuse results instead of re-checking.

near.description: A cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91) or a hotel area.

tools.name: plan_cruise_trip
tools.description: Build a day-by-day plan for a Seattle cruise departure, the same plan the seatac.co sailing page shows: fly into Seatac, ride to a hotel near the pier (or straight to the ship on sailing day), the ride to the terminal, and the ride home or one more night after the cruise. Each step has its booking link and cost: ride estimates from Seatac's own pricing (the all-in total with fee and tax when the site shows all-in prices, otherwise whole-dollar fares before fee and tax; final price at booking), typical hotel rates, and a flight comparison link. Needs the ship and sailing date (use find_cruise_sailings first if unsure). Pass hotel_slug from hotel_options to put a hotel in the plan and the total.

ship.description: Ship name, any case; partial names work ("Bliss").

home_airport.description: Optional 3-letter code of the airport they fly from, e.g. ORD.

arrive.description: When they fly in: same_day, day_before (default), or two_days_before.

arrival_date.description: Or an exact arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD), up to 14 days before sailing.

arrival_flight.description: Optional arriving flight number, e.g. AS 342, prefilled on the airport ride.

hotel_slug.description: Optional hotel from hotel_options (a previous call) to include in the plan and total.

hotel_name.description: Optional name of another hotel they already booked.

after_cruise.description: airport (default): straight to the airport; hotel: one more night in Seattle.

tools.name: plan_seattle_trip
tools.description: Plan a Seattle visit day by day, the same plan as seatac.co/seattle-trip-planner: a work trip, seeing family, a game or concert, or a holiday (for a cruise use plan_cruise_trip). Give the dates; everything else is optional and can be added on later calls. Returns each day in order: arrival (flight, the Seatac ride with its pickup time and estimate), the hotel, each day's plan from morning to evening with meetings at their set times, meals, experiences and events, the estimated travel time between stops and a ride link for each leg, warnings when something won't fit, suggested restaurants and experiences for empty parts of the day, games and concerts on each date with ticket links, the ride back to the airport timed from the flight home, hotel options ranked for the trip (nearest the meetings for work), an estimated total, and plan_page_url, which opens exactly this plan for the traveler to change and book. Nothing is assumed booked. Read-only; no payment.

start.description: Day they arrive in Seattle, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Day they leave, YYYY-MM-DD (same as start for a day trip). Or give nights.

nights.description: Nights in Seattle instead of end (0-21, default 2).

purpose.description: What the trip is for: business, visit, event, vacation or other. Business ranks hotels by the meetings and defaults to 1 traveler.

arrive_by.description: fly (default), drive, train (King Street Station), bus, ferry (Colman Dock or Pier 69), or other.

arrival_place.description: train, bus, ferry or other: where they arrive (a bus stop, a ferry terminal). Defaults: King Street Station for the train, Colman Dock for the ferry.

home_airport.description: 3-letter code of the airport they fly from, e.g. ORD.

landing_time.description: Landing time at Seatac, Seattle time HH:MM. Sets the airport pickup and the first afternoon.

departure_time.description: Flight home's departure, Seattle time HH:MM. Sets the last day and the ride to the airport.

hotel_slug.description: One of our hotels (slug from hotel_options).

hotel_name.description: Or a hotel they booked elsewhere, "name, address".

meetings.description: Meetings or appointments at set times (up to 10).

name.description: What it is, e.g. Client meeting.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day of the trip.

address.description: Where it is, e.g. "Amazon Spheres, 2111 7th Ave, Seattle, WA".

lat.description: Optional latitude of the address, for travel times.

lng.description: Optional longitude of the address, for travel times.

picks.description: Things to put on the plan (up to 30): a pick_id from suggestions, events, find_things_to_do or find_restaurants, a date, and optionally the part of the day.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day of the trip.

part.description: morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner or evening (default: when it usually fits).

suggestions.description: Suggest restaurants and experiences for empty parts of each day (default true).

tools.name: compare_airport_options
tools.description: Compare every way to get between Seatac Airport (SEA) and a Seattle-area place for one trip: a private Seatac Co ride, driving and parking at the SEA garage, a rental car, app rideshare or taxi, and Link light rail. Priced options carry real numbers (Port of Seattle garage rates, typical rental costs, example or live ride fares); rideshare and light rail are described, not priced, because their prices are not fixed. direction: "departing" (flying out of SEA: the alternative is parking), "arriving" (visiting: the alternative is a rental), or "both". Ranks the priced options cheapest first.

trip_days.description: Length of the trip in days (1-30): days parked, or nights in town for a rental.

area.description: Seattle-area place the trip starts or ends at (default downtown-seattle).

direction.description: departing = a local flying out of SEA (compare parking); arriving = a visitor flying in (compare a rental); both (default).

rental_daily_rate.description: Optional: the traveler's own daily rental rate before tax, USD.

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

tools.name: compare_parking_vs_ride
tools.description: Compare parking at the Seatac (SEA) airport garage for a trip with a round-trip private ride to and from the airport, using the same numbers as seatac.co/parking: Port of Seattle drive-up rates (taxes included) against example sedan fares from seven Seattle-area starting points. Returns both totals, which is cheaper and by how much, and the trip length where the ride starts winning. Optional: pass address + pickup_datetime for a live fare (one rate-limited quote).

days.description: Days the car would be parked (whole 24-hour days, 1-60).

from_area.description: Where the traveler drives from (default downtown-seattle).

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

tools.name: compare_rental_vs_ride
tools.description: Compare renting a car at Seatac (SEA) for a stay with a private ride from the airport and back, as seatac.co/seatac-car-rental does: typical SEA daily rate, taxes and airport fees, the facility charge, and hotel parking every night (gas left out), against example sedan fares. Override the daily rate or hotel parking with the traveler's own quote. Returns the breakdown, which is cheaper, a ride booking link, and a rental search link (partner; seatac.co may earn a commission). Optional live fare with address + pickup_datetime (one rate-limited quote).

nights.description: Nights in town (1-30); the rental runs one day per night.

rental_daily_rate.description: Optional: the traveler's own daily rental rate before tax, USD.

hotel_parking_per_night.description: Optional: the hotel's overnight parking per night, USD.

start_date.description: Optional rental pickup date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the rental search link.

address.description: Optional exact pickup/drop-off address in the Seattle area for a live fare instead of the stored example fare, e.g. "1301 5th Ave, Seattle". Needs pickup_datetime. Uses one rate-limited live quote.

pickup_datetime.description: With address: the ride's pickup date and time, ISO 8601, Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T14:30.

passengers.description: Passengers for the live fare (1-12, default 2).

bags.description: Checked-size bags for the live fare (0-12, default 2).

tools.name: recommend_hotels_with_rides
tools.description: Recommend Seattle hotels for a stay with the whole-trip cost: typical room rate for the nights plus the rides the stay needs (Seatac → hotel on check-in day, then hotel → cruise pier or back to Seatac on check-out day). near is a cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91: check-out day is sailing day) or a hotel area. For a pier it also prices a SeaTac airport hotel, so the traveler can see when a cheaper airport room plus rides beats a downtown room. Room links lead; ride links are the add-on. Typical rates and ride estimates, not live prices.

near.description: A cruise pier (pier-66, pier-91) or a hotel area.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD (sailing day for a pier).

compare_airport_hotel.description: For a pier: also price a SeaTac airport hotel (default true).

tools.name: find_events_near
tools.description: Find Seattle-area games, concerts and shows on given dates (from Seatac Co's daily Ticketmaster snapshot), the same list seatac.co shows as "Happening while you're here". With near (the airport, a cruise pier, or a hotel area) events are nearest first, one per venue, within 20 miles, with the straight-line distance; without it, the biggest events first. Each event has its start time, the planned ride (pickup time to arrive 45 minutes early, estimated end, ride back), a prefilled round-trip booking link, the event page and the ticket link.

to.description: Last date, inclusive (up to 14 days after from). Omit for one day.

near.description: Where the traveler is: sea-airport, a cruise pier, or a hotel area. Omit for the biggest events.

ride_from.description: Optional address the ride to the event starts from (e.g. their hotel), prefilled in the booking link.

tools.name: find_things_to_do
tools.description: Seattle experiences the trip planner offers (Space Needle and Chihuly Garden, a harbor cruise, the Museum of Flight, food tours and more): what each is, how long it takes, which parts of the day it fits, rough price level, where it is, a ticket link, and with hotel_slug about how long it takes to get there. Each has a pick_id to pass to plan_seattle_trip's picks.

part.description: Only those that fit this part of the day.

hotel_slug.description: Our hotel (from plan_seattle_trip's hotel_options) to estimate travel time from.

tools.name: find_restaurants
tools.description: Places to eat in Seattle from the trip planner's own list, for breakfast, lunch or dinner, nearest first to an area (pike-place, waterfront, downtown, pioneer-square, queen-anne, airport) or one of our hotels: cuisine, price level, address, a one-line why, a map link, and with hotel_slug about how long it takes to get there. Each has a pick_id for plan_seattle_trip's picks.

near.description: Area to start from (default downtown, or the hotel's area).

hotel_slug.description: Our hotel (from plan_seattle_trip's hotel_options): nearest it first, with travel time.

tools.name: plan_airport_departure
tools.description: Work out when to leave for Seatac (SEA) for a departing flight, the seatac.co departure planner's rule: be at the terminal 2 hours before a domestic or 3 hours before an international departure (SEA's advice), minus Seatac's stored typical drive from the starting point. Returns the terminal-arrival target, the pickup time, a prefilled ride booking link, and how long before departure to leave from each place we have a drive time for.

departure_datetime.description: Scheduled departure, ISO 8601; Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:15.

international.description: true for an international flight (3-hour rule); default false (2 hours).

from.description: Starting point with a stored drive time.

drive_minutes.description: Optional drive time in minutes (5-240) when starting elsewhere; overrides the stored time.

pickup_address.description: Optional exact pickup address, prefilled in the booking link.
